title: RBI Eases FPI G-Sec Investment Norms & Merges General/Long-Term Limits
summary: Removes short-term, security-wise, and concentration limits for FPIs under General Route.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Eases FPI G-Sec Investment Norms & Merges General/Long-Term Limits. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Removes short-term, security-wise, and concentration limits for FPIs under General Route.
Limit Removal: Withdrew short-term, security-wise, and concentration limits for FPI (foreign portfolio investors holding liquid assets) G-Sec investments.
Limit Merging: Merged general and long-term sub-limits into a single limit for Central & State Government Securities (SGSs).
FAR Designation: Designated 15-yr, 30-yr, and 40-yr G-Secs under Fully Accessible Route (FAR).
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
